summary: Sumter County Schools urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate funding to maintain affordable, reliable internet connectivity for students and communities.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, Sumter County Schools cannot afford network upgrades and would face financial burdens
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, given the high rates of child poverty, low median household income, and limited local revenue-generating capacity in our community, the district cannot easily absorb the costs associated with replacing this critical federal support.
